items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: It was Freddie Hubbard and Pookie and Punchy, Joe something on piano and Paul Parker on drums, and the three brothers. They were the five others.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's late to be making up your mind, living with that kind of thing. But it was very, very successful. I remember...Freddie Hubbard's also from my home town, that's where he was. He used to come out to play.
